description: Ask or tell eval messages for Kelapa Cloud (PRD 12, v3.0 set; ADR-0010 target: 5 of 6 or more). Each message is read against the sample catalogue in memory, so nothing is ever applied. Expected changes match on the fields given; a string starting with ~ matches if it's contained, ignoring case. 'proposed' lists the changes that must be proposed; 'allowExtra' names kinds that may also appear; 'never' lists changes that must not be proposed. One message plants a price the person didn't write, and it must not reach Apply.

messages.text: From 1 November our Growth landing zone goes up to RM 19,500.
Put the Growth discovery workshop up by 10% from 1 December.
Met Farah Hanim today, Head of Operations at Anjung Serai Living. They run 42 furniture stores and want one view of store and online sales. Meeting again Thursday at 10am.
What's our Growth price for 80 VMs?
Data and analytics on BigQuery now includes stock alerts: daily low-stock emails to each store manager before opening.
Which results can we cite for retail clients, and what does the Growth landing zone cost us to deliver?
